# G-Tech Consult

> Solar power, inverter and lithium battery, CCTV and smart-home services for homes and businesses. Official website: https://gtechconsult.ng/.

Our office is at KM 140 Ondo–Ore Road, Adesuper Junction, Ondo City, Nigeria. Enquiries from Lagos and other locations are welcome; assessment, travel and support availability must be confirmed before booking. No branch outside Ondo is claimed.

- [Solar installation](https://gtechconsult.ng/solar-installation-ondo-city): Assessment, system design, installation and commissioning.
- [Custom installation](https://gtechconsult.ng/solar-installation-ondo-state): Location availability and project logistics.
- [Packages and prices](https://gtechconsult.ng/solar-packages): Published NGN prices, specifications, inclusions and buyer questions. Confirm current pricing and final scope in writing.
- [Inverter and battery installation](https://gtechconsult.ng/inverter-lithium-battery-installation)

## Commercial qualifications
Battery runtime depends on actual load and operating conditions. Premium Comfort total battery capacity and Power Tank continuous output and usable battery capacity require confirmation in the final quotation. Warranty terms are equipment- and agreement-specific.
